encounterData.name: Bridge Ambush
encounterData.description: Goblins hold the rope bridge over the gorge, with archers on the far side.

notes.gm: The bridge is rigged to collapse once the hazard is triggered. The warchief flees once bloodied.
notes.monster: The goblin dog stays hidden in the rigging until it attacks.
notes.player:
The bridge sways under every step.
The toll keeper watches from his hut.
